notes: Missoula County unincorporated base zoning districts (county Zoning Regulations). basedistrictabbrv holds a long code (e.g. 02.C.02.BASE.02.03.R.BAS); the district code is its 7th dot-part. new_fullzoning holds the district name. Some features carry city-annexed or county right-of-way domain codes; exclude those if they appear.
